facts.text: I am planning a trip to New Zealand and Australia next year.
I am thinking of spending at least two weeks in each country (New Zealand and Australia).
I just got back from a family vacation in Cancun, Mexico.
I went on a solo trip to Portland, Oregon from May 28th to May 31st to attend a friend's wedding.
I explored Portland, Oregon during my solo trip and had an amazing time.
In Portland, I tried Voodoo Doughnut for the first time.
In Portland, I had the Voodoo Doll doughnut at Voodoo Doughnut.
In Portland, I stayed in the Hawthorne neighborhood.
The Hawthorne neighborhood was super hip and had cool cafes and vintage shops.
In Cancun, I visited the ancient Mayan ruins of Chichen Itza.
Our guide in Chichen Itza was named Carlos.
In Portland, I hiked in Forest Park.
In Portland, I stayed in an Airbnb in the Hawthorne neighborhood.
